structured_output.what_is_happening: AMC "A mini cock" is an 11-minute-old pump.fun coin still on the bonding curve, at about $15.7k market cap. It appears to be one of a burst of "AMC" launches, probably all reacting to the same X post by @RealDesertDoge (the post is linked in the packet but returned 402 when fetched). At least 7 other AMC tokens launched within minutes of each other: pair timestamps 1790394372 to 1790395182, including "A MEME COIN", "A Meme Coin", another "A mini cock" and "cant have pairing + paid". This one is the volume leader, with $85k h1 volume and 580 unique buyers. It already peaked near 2x its launch price (ATH price 3.05e-5) and is now dumping: m5 is -30% on DexScreener and -65% on GeckoTerminal, and in the last 5 minutes unique sellers (227) outnumbered unique buyers (192). The deployer has launched 361 tokens. Fees go to @ceoadam via UsePaid, a fee-routing pattern commonly used in X-bait launches. GMGN tags 151 wallets as bundlers.

narrative.description: A crude joke name riding a short-lived ticker meta: an X post, probably from @RealDesertDoge, set off many pump.fun deployers racing to launch 'AMC'. The UsePaid fee routing to @ceoadam suggests the aim is to get a named X user to engage.
narrative.why_spreading: A copy-launch race on one X post, plus fee-bait aimed at @ceoadam. I could not verify any organic cultural event.

token_connection.why_this_token: Among the new AMC launches it has the highest market cap and volume, and it carries the socials and link that tie it to the X post. That makes it the de facto leader for now.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 8 other AMC/AMCOCK tokens launched within minutes, 2 of them with the same name ('A mini cock'). There is also an old AMC at $316k with no activity.

authenticity.evidence: 580 unique buyers in about 15 minutes suggests some real degen participation, but GMGN tags 151 wallets as bundlers. The deployer is a serial launcher (361 tokens). A community-takeover flag is set, and the UsePaid fee-bait mechanism is in use.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the X post, so I could not see its engagement, or whether @ceoadam or DesertDoge endorsed this particular contract.

structural_risks: 151 wallets tagged as bundlers; a 4-wallet insider transfer network
already down about 50% from ATH, with sellers outnumbering buyers in the latest 5 minutes
small bonding-curve depth, so a few dumps move the price a lot

structured_output.counterargument: It leads the ticker race, top-10 holders own only about 13.5%, and dev holdings are zero. If @ceoadam or DesertDoge acknowledges this contract, it could retest the $31k ATH (2x) and head toward migration at around $35k+. That is a short trip for an active meta coin.

source_coverage.notes: The X status returned 402 and usepaid.app failed with an SSL error. Searches for the contract address and the name found nothing relevant. Time was short, so I did not search Reddit, Telegram or Discord.

structured_output.thesis: This is a clone-race joke coin from a serial deployer. It already made its 2x and is dumping hard at detection. A narrow chance remains that it retests the ATH if the targeted X accounts engage. It ranks below average.
